messages:
Ravi P: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — we agreed to track remediation items and decide on any SLO/SLA changes. Opening thread to confirm owners + timelines.
Dina M: I have the perf traces: root cause looks like autoscaler flapping + a short surge of requests during feature rollout. Throughput dipped ~30% for 6m causing queued requests and higher latency.
Oliver: Do we have error-budget numbers? Need to know if this is urgent for recalibration.
slo-bot: Weekly SLO summary: 99th latency breached for 7m; SLO: p95 < 400ms, p99 < 900ms. Weekly error budget used: 1.1%. Monthly remaining: 96.5%.
Ravi P: Thanks. Given the p99 breach and repeated small flaps in the last 60 days, propose: 1) remediation owner for autoscaler tuning (Dina), 2) dashboard for deploy-time throughput + queue depth (Oliver), 3) short-term mitigation (rate-limit rollout traffic), 4) decide on SLO change only if recurrence persists.
Dina M: I can own autoscaler tuning. Plan: adjust cooldowns, add a gradual scale-up window, and add better metrics for tie-breakers. ETA: PR in 10 days, rollout in 18 days.
Sam: I'll help with rollout throttling feature. We can gate new feature traffic with a progressive ramp over 30 minutes. I can have a feature flag and rollout script in 4 days.
Oliver: I'll own dashboards. Will add tiles: deploy markers, throughput, queue depth, p50/p95/p99 latency, and a burn gauge for error budget. Draft by Fri EOD.
Ravi P: Good. Let's also create two alert tiers: alert on p95>400ms for 3m (info) and p99>900ms for 1m (page). That keeps sensitivity but escalates on severe tail. Thoughts?
Dina M: Agree. Also recommend adding an automated checklist that runs pre-deploy: smoke load test hitting connector endpoints to validate scale-up.
Sam: I can add pre-deploy smoke in CI pipeline. Quick run should be <5m. Will add by next Wed.
Oliver: Dashboard note: include a 7d rolling error-budget trend and a widget that flags weekly burn >0.5% automatically.
Ravi P: Comms: if we change SLA numbers we need Product sign-off. For now keep SLOs and add mitigations. If Matt (product) approves recalibration later, Priya will handle customer messaging.
Dina M: Recurrence analysis: I scanned last 60 days — 6 minor spikes, 4 of them aligned with deploy windows. I'll add that appendix to the postmortem doc by Thu.
Ravi P: Action list recap:
- Dina: autoscaler tuning RFC + PR by 10 days, roll in 18 days
- Sam: rollout gating + pre-deploy smoke in CI by next Wed
- Oliver: dashboard updates + alert suggestions by Fri EOD
- Ravi: schedule SLO review with Product next Tue
- Dina: recurrence appendix by Thu

slo-bot: Created SLO ticket SLO-701 assigned to Dina, due 2036209500.
ops-bot: Created task OPS-498 "deploy-rollout-gating" assigned to Sam, due 2036210800.
Oliver: I'll also add a list of deploy-time owners to the dashboard and a link to the playbook for on-call.
Ravi P: Good. If the recurrence analysis shows >3 similar events in 30 days we will reconvene and consider SLO recalibration. Otherwise we keep SLOs and focus on mitigations.
Sam: Did we decide whether to adjust alert thresholds for cost/noise? I prefer keep p95 alert but lower noisy noise by increasing noise-suppression window to 3m.
Ravi P: Agreed: p95 alert window 3m, p99 page window 1m. Oliver, please prototype in dashboard and set alerts accordingly.
Oliver: Will do. Link to draft: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/ux789/deploy-insights
Dina M: Adding a short-term mitigation: stop automatic concurrent rollouts across zones for 48h while we roll out autoscaler fixes. Ops-runbook updated.
Ravi P: Thanks. I'll update the postmortem action tracker and assign owners in the SLO board. Meeting follow-up scheduled in 2036207600.
ops-bot: Reminder set for follow-up meeting 2036207600.
Ravi P: Thanks everyone — please paste PR links and dashboard snapshots here when ready.
